scope: Installed vanilla smoke source and class config inspection; no client or JIP acceptance. Native source is not redistributed.
findings: The class test_EmptyObjectForSmoke invokes the installed smoke.sqf in its init handler.
The script creates two local particle sources (ObjectDestructionSmokeSmallx and ObjectDestructionSmoke1_2Smallx), plus a local light, and attaches them to the smoke object.
The three effects are retained in the object effects variable.
The class Deleted handler deletes every object from that effects variable.
